title: Global Medic 2010: C-17 Landing
description: B-roll of a C-17 from Charleston AFB landing, taking off, and the off loading a firetruck and forklift. Global Medic is an annual medical exercise designed to replicate all aspects of combat service support on the battlefield and allow participating combat support units to train as they fight in a joint environment. One of the largest medical command and control exercises between the U.S. Army Reserve and the U.S. Air Force Reserve, Global Medic serves as an effective means to train medical units and staff for real-world missions. Produced by Senior Master Sgt. Anthony Rizo.
